notes.title: Devlog #4 on Sunday, August 11th at 8:00 PM CET + Contest, remember the date!
notes.content:
🔥  🇬🇧  Devlog #4 on Sunday, August 11th at 8:00 PM CET + Contest, remember the date!

On our Twitch

ːsteamthisː Important announcement! 

Join us on the Sunday, August 11th at 8:00 PM CET on Twitch for a major Devlog! 

What's on the agenda:


 Project's status
 Team members introduction with their roles
 Announcements (Partnerships, Tiktok campaign...)
 Plenty of new visual content
 The very first gameplay showcase!


Come and play with us to earn Alpha coins that you will be able to use as soon as the a0.8 is out!

Stay tuned, we cannot wait to show you amazing content and preview of the new game's version with a lot of Alpha coins to be earned for each of you!

The stream will be in French 🇫🇷 but important announcements will be also done in English, enjoy!

Stay tuned on:


 Discord
 Twitch
 Youtube

notes.title: 🔥 a0.8 Playtests coming soon...!
notes.content:
🔥  🇬🇧  The a0.8 Playtests will start soon! We can't wait to show you the totally revamped version of the game with the brand new Factions!!!

Stay tuned on Twitch, the date will be scheduled soon.

On our Twitch

Come influence the future of Rise of the Robots X by discovering lots about a0.8:
New chests
New Robots
New card acquisition system
New competitive organization
😱 And more teasers!

We will listen to your feedback to make adjustments and perfect this new version of the game.

The evening will feature various games with rewards up for grabs! Win a0.8 currency, stickers, chests...

The stream will be in French 🇫🇷, enjoy!

notes.title: Demo is paused until a0.8 on July 17th 2024, Playtests start on June 12th
notes.content:
DEMO IS PAUSED

Follow our Devlogs on:

 Twitch
 Discord
 Youtube
 X
 

We are working hard to release the new and upgraded version of the game (a0.8). Thanks to everyone for the quality testing and feedbacks.

Release date for the Playtests / Alpha a0.8 version : June 12th, Demo will be released on July 17th.

What will change:
- 🎏 Factions system, select 1 faction to fight for and get access to an exclusive Robot family and other powerful bonuses
- 👶 Onboarding tutorial!
- 🏝️ Improved graphics by a lot
- 🧩 Revamped UI
- 🥇 Loads of new missions
